UPrint.pas::PrintDevice.text: Builds the description of a printer's page.

params.HorzMm: printable width of the page, mm
params.VertMm: printable height of the page, mm

UPrint.pas::PrintFitScale.text: The largest scale at which the whole sheet fits on one page (the longer printer side against the longer side of a landscape sheet, or against the height of a portrait one), as DoPreparePrinting works out m_FitScale. 100 when a size is nought.

UPrint.pas::PrintZoom.text: The zoom OnBeginPrinting gives the transform: dpi * 1000 / (5 * 254) as an integer division (the pixels of a unit at 100 per cent, times 100), times the scale over 100, over 100.
UPrint.pas::PrintZoom.returns: printer pixels for each internal unit

UPrint.pas::PrintLayoutFor.text: OnBeginPrinting: the sheet's size at the scale, over the printer's page (its long side along the sheet's long side, whichever way the sheet is turned), gives the pages across and down; a part of a page left over counts as a page unless it is 0.01 of one or less. A scale so small that nothing is left still takes one page (TinyCAD would then print no pages and fail).

params.SheetCount: number of sheets in the design

UPrint.pas::PrintPageAt.text: OnPrepareDC. Printing all sheets, the sheets go round fastest (page 1 is the first part of sheet 1, page 2 the first part of sheet 2, ...); the parts of a sheet go down a column and then across. The part's corner is its column or row times the printer's page (whole mm times 5 units) over the scale, as whole units.
UPrint.pas::PrintPageAt.returns: which sheet and part of it the page shows

UPrint.pas::FormatCG.text: printf("%*.*g"): the number to Prec significant digits, in plain form when its exponent is from -4 up to Prec - 1 and in the e+XX form otherwise, with trailing zeros dropped.

params.Width: least number of characters (padded with spaces on the left)

UPrint.pas::PrintScaleText.text: The Print dialog's _stprintf("%3.3lg"): three significant digits, at least three characters wide, so 5 reads "  5" and 97.34 reads "97.3".
UPrint.pas::PrintScaleText.returns: the text of the Scale box

UPrint.pas::CAtof.text: atof: leading spaces, an optional sign, digits with an optional point, and an optional exponent; anything after that is ignored.
UPrint.pas::CAtof.returns: the number at the start of the text, 0 if there is none

UPrint.pas::PrintScaleValue.text: The Print dialog's _tstof of the box.

params.S: the text of the Scale box

UPrint.pas::PrintRangePages.text: A page range cut down to the pages that exist; a range turned the wrong way round is turned back; no range prints every page.
UPrint.pas::PrintRangePages.returns: True if there is anything to print

params.Pages: the number of pages in the print
params.FromPage: first page asked for, 0 for no range

UPrintRun.pas::TPrintSink.RendersCopies.text: By default a sink does not, and the print job sends the pages again for each copy.
UPrintRun.pas::TPrintSink.RendersCopies.returns: True if the printer makes the copies itself

UPrintRun.pas::TPrintSink.SetCopies.text: Asks the printer for that many copies; only used when it makes them itself.

UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.Create.text: The installed printer, turned to the sheet's orientation as TinyCAD does before it makes its device context.

params.Portrait: True to print the tall way

UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.Available.text: Whether there is a printer to print on.
UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.Available.returns: True if a printer is installed

UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.Device.text: The width and height of the printable page in whole millimetres, and the resolution, as GetDeviceCaps gives them.

UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.PageWidth.text: The printable width of the page in printer pixels.

UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.PageHeight.text: The printable height of the page in printer pixels.

UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.Name.text: The name of the printer in use.

UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.RendersCopie.text: Whether the printer makes the copies itself.
UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.RendersCopie.returns: True if the driver can make several copies

UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.SetCopies.text: Tells the printer how many copies to make.

params.Title: the name of the print job

UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.Canvas.text: The canvas of the page being printed.

UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.NewPage.text: Ends the page and starts the next.

UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.EndDoc.text: Ends the print job, which sends it to the printer.

UPrintRun.pas::TPrinterSink.Abort.text: Stops a print job that failed part way.

UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.Create.text: A page of A4 paper that only exists as bitmaps.

params.Portrait: True for an A4 page the tall way
params.AOutDir: a folder to write each page to as a PNG file at the end ('' for none)

UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.Device.text: The page's size in millimetres and its resolution.

UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.PageWidth.text: The page's width at its resolution.

UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.PageHeight.text: The page's height at its resolution.

UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.Available.text: A bitmap can always be drawn on.

UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.BeginDoc.text: Starts a job: any pages of an earlier job are dropped and the first page is made.

UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.NewPage.text: Adds a white page and draws on that.

UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.Canvas.text: The canvas to draw the current page on.
UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.Canvas.returns: the canvas of the latest page

UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.EndDoc.text: Ends the job; the pages are written to the output folder if there is one.

UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.Abort.text: Drops the pages of a job that failed.

UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.PageCount.text: How many pages the last job made.

UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.Page.text: One of the pages the last job made.
UPrintRun.pas::TVirtualSink.Page.returns: the page's bitmap (owned by the sink)

UPrintRun.pas::SheetIsPortrait.text: CDetails::IsPortrait: the page is turned the tall way when its width is less than its height.
UPrintRun.pas::SheetIsPortrait.returns: True if the sheet is taller than it is wide

UPrintRun.pas::DefaultPrintOptions.text: The options of a print that asks nothing: every page, the sheet shown or all the sheets as asked.
UPrintRun.pas::DefaultPrintOptions.returns: one copy of everything, at the scale in the settings

UPrintRun.pas::PrintLayoutOf.text: OnBeginPrinting: the size of the sheet showing (not of the others) against the printer's page, at the scale chosen.

UPrintRun.pas::RenderPrintPage.text: Draws a printed page: the sheet's border, title block and rulers and then its objects, with the transform OnPrepareDC sets (the corner of the part of the sheet this page shows, and the print zoom). Nothing is drawn outside the page. The canvas is not cleared.

params.ActiveSheet: the sheet showing (the one printed when not all are)
params.PxW: width of the canvas in pixels
params.PxH: height of the canvas in pixels
params.Factor: 1 on the printer; a smaller number draws the whole page smaller (a preview)

UPrintRun.pas::RunPrintJob.text: The print: the pages of the range, once for each copy. When the printer makes the copies itself it is asked for them; otherwise a collated print sends the whole range again for each copy, and an uncollated one sends each page as many times as there are copies. A job that fails part way is aborted and the error passes on.
UPrintRun.pas::RunPrintJob.returns: the number of pages sent to the sink for one copy; 0 when the range asks for no page that exists

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.FormCreate.text: Hooks up the check made when OK is pressed.

params.Sender: the component that raised the event

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.SetPrint.text: Fills the dialog as it starts: the scale as text, black and white, the current sheet chosen (TinyCAD's radio buttons start at the first), no Fit.

params.ASheetW: width of the sheet showing, internal units
params.ASheetCount: the number of sheets in the design
params.AAvailable: True if there is a printer to print on
params.AScale: the scale kept in the settings
params.BW: the black and white choice kept in the settings

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.SetRange.text: Sets the pages and copies (what the Printer button's dialog decided) and shows them.

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.SetDevice.text: The printer was changed in the system's Print dialog: the pages are laid out again on its page.

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.RangeText.text: "Pages: all" or "Pages: 2-3", then the copies, and "collated" when they are.
Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.RangeText.returns: the pages and copies as the dialog shows them

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.GetOptions.text: The scale is read from its box as _tstof does (0 when it is no number); the other choices come from the boxes and from the Printer button's dialog.
Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.GetOptions.returns: what the dialog says to print

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.PageCount.text: How many pages the whole print is at the scale in the box.
Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.PageCount.returns: the number of pages the print takes (0 when the scale is no use)

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.PagesText.text: "4 pages: 2 across and 2 down" for each sheet, with "on each of 3 sheets" when all the sheets are printed, or the reason the scale is no use.
Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.PagesText.returns: the line that says how many pages the print takes

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.UpdateTexts.text: Shows the printer, the pages and copies, and the number of pages.

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.ValidationError.text: The scale must be above 0 and at most 10000 per cent (TinyCAD takes any number; a scale of 0 stops it, and a huge one makes it try for millions of pages).
Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.ValidationError.returns: the message, empty when the scale will do

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.OptionChanged.text: Updates the number of pages after the scale or the sheets chosen change.

params.Sender: the component that raised the event

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.cbBWClick.text: CSpecialPrintDlg::OnBandw: the choice is kept in the settings at once.

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.cbFitClick.text: CSpecialPrintDlg::OnFit: ticked, the box shows the scale that fits the sheet on one page and cannot be typed in; unticked, it can be and shows the scale the dialog started with.

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.btnPrinterClick.text: Shows the system's Print dialog for the printer, pages and copies (the handler does that).

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.CloseQuery.text: Pressing OK checks the scale first and keeps the dialog open with a message if it is no use.

params.CanClose: set False to keep the dialog open

Fprint.pas::TfrmPrint.KeepInSettings.text: CSpecialPrintDlg::OnOK: the scale in the box is kept in the settings (with the black and white choice, which was kept when it was clicked).

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.FormCreate.text: Starts with the first page, one page at a time, the whole page showing.

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.Destroy.text: Frees the page bitmaps and the printer's page.

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.ClearCache.text: Drops every page that was drawn, so they are drawn again at the new size.

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.SetPreview.text: Lays the pages out (OnBeginPrinting) and shows the first.

params.ASink: the printer's page (the window keeps it)
params.AOpt: scale, black and white and sheets

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.Shown.text: One, or two in two-page mode when there is a page after the current.

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.FitFactor.text: The largest pages (one, or two side by side) that fit the window with a margin round them.
Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.FitFactor.returns: the size of a page that fits the window, over the printer's page

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.Relayout.text: Works out the size of the pages from the zoom and the window, sizes the paint box to hold them (the window scrolls when they are larger) and redraws.

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.UpdateButtons.text: Dims what cannot be done (no next page after the last, no more zoom) and says which page is showing.

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.BitmapOf.text: Draws the page on first use and keeps it until the size changes.
Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.BitmapOf.returns: the page, drawn on white paper at the size of the shown pages

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.PageBitmap.returns: the page as the preview draws it, nil if there is no such page

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.pbPagePaint.text: Draws the shown page or pages with a shadow, on the grey background.

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.NextPage.text: The Next Page button: the pages after the ones showing (nothing at the end).

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.PrevPage.text: The Prev Page button: the pages before the ones showing (nothing at the start).

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.ToggleTwoPage.text: The One Page / Two Page button. The page showing stays the first of those shown.

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.ZoomIn.text: The Zoom In button: the pages one step larger (up to three steps over the whole page).

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.ZoomOut.text: The Zoom Out button: the pages one step smaller (down to the whole page).

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.pbPageMouseUp.text: A click on the pages zooms in a step, and from the largest size goes back to the whole page (MFC's preview does the same).

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.FormResize.text: The pages are made to fit the new window size.

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.FormKeyDown.text: Page Down / Page Up change pages, Escape closes the window.

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.FormCloseQuery.text: The window can always be closed.

params.CanClose: set False to keep the window open

Fpreview.pas::TfrmPreview.InfoText.text: For tests: "page=3 shown=2 pages=8 two=1 zoom=0 next=1 prev=1 zoomin=1 zoomout=0 twocaption=... status=...".

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.DoPageSetup.text: Handler: shows the Page Setup dialog for the current sheet and applies it on OK.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.ReportProblem.text: Tells the person something went wrong: a warning box, or, when the program is run from a script (quiet), the status bar's first panel, so that scripts and tests can read it.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.PrinterInstalled.text: Whether there is a printer to print on.
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.PrinterInstalled.returns: True if the system has a printer

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.MakePrintSink.text: The installed printer turned to the orientation, or an A4 page that is only a bitmap when there is no printer (or when a test has asked for bitmap pages).
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.MakePrintSink.returns: where the pages go; the caller frees it

params.Portrait: True for the tall way (the sheet's orientation)

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.BeginPrintDialog.text: The start of File > Print (CTinyCadView::OnPreparePrinting and DoPreparePrinting): any drawing tool is put away, the printer's page is found for the way the sheet is turned, and the dialog gets the sheet's size, the scale and black and white of the settings, the current sheet, and every page once.
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.BeginPrintDialog.returns: the dialog, filled as it starts; the caller shows it and frees it

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.ChoosePrinter.text: The Printer button: the system's Print dialog (a TPrintDialog) for the printer, the pages and the copies, started with what the dialog has now. The pages the print takes are shown for choosing a range. The page the printer now has is the one the dialog lays pages out on. With no printer installed it says so.
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.ChoosePrinter.returns: True if the system's Print dialog was accepted

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.FinishPrintDialog.text: OK (when it is not dimmed) keeps the scale in the settings and prints the pages asked for on the printer (the printer is turned the way the sheet showing is; the layout is made from that sheet, as TinyCAD does). A print that fails says why. Cancel prints nothing.
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.FinishPrintDialog.returns: the pages sent to the printer for one copy, or -1 when nothing was printed

params.F: the dialog, after a button was pressed

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.DoPrint.text: Handler (File > Print...): shows the Print dialog and prints what it asks for.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.PrintScriptRun.text: For tests: File > Print answered the way a person does, without showing the dialog.
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.PrintScriptRun.returns: what the dialog showed when it started, the choices when the button was pressed, and what happened

params.Opts: name=value answers: scale (text typed in the Scale box), bw (0 or 1), sheets (current, all), fit (0 or 1), from, to, copies, collate (the pages and copies the system's Print dialog would give) and press (ok, cancel)

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.BeginPreview.text: The start of File > Print Preview: any drawing tool is put away (OnPreparePrinting), and the pages are those of every sheet at the scale and black and white of the settings, on the printer's page (an A4 page with no printer).
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.BeginPreview.returns: the window, with its pages laid out; the caller shows it and frees it

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.DoPrintPreview.text: Handler (File > Print Preview): shows the preview; its Print button goes on to the Print dialog.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.PreviewScriptRun.text: For tests: File > Print Preview worked like a person, without showing the window.
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.PreviewScriptRun.returns: the window's state when it opened and after each action

params.Ops: what is done, in order: next, prev, two, zoomin, zoomout, page=<n> (the page is drawn and kept as page_<n>.png in PrintSinkDir), info (nothing) and last press=close or press=print

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.DoPrintSetup.text: Handler (File > Print Setup...): the system's dialog for the printer and its settings (a TPrinterSetupDialog). With no printer it says so.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.PrinterPageFor.text: What the Printer Paper and Printer Setup buttons of the Page Setup dialog ask for (CDlgPageSizeBox::SetPrinter). With no printer it says so and returns False; a cancelled dialog also returns False.
mainform.pas::TfrmMain.PrinterPageFor.returns: True if there is a printer page to use

params.Choose: True to show the printer's page setup dialog (a TPageSetupDialog) first
params.HorzMm: the printer's page width in whole millimetres

Fpagesetup.pas::TfrmPageSetup.UsePrinter.text: The printer's page (CDlgPageSizeBox: the larger side against the smaller, in whole millimetres) becomes the sheet's size, the larger side being the width for landscape and the height for portrait. Does nothing when there is no printer or the setup is cancelled.
Fpagesetup.pas::TfrmPageSetup.UsePrinter.returns: True if the boxes were filled from the printer

params.Choose: True to show the printer's setup dialog first

Fpagesetup.pas::TfrmPageSetup.btnPrinter.text: The Printer Paper button: the size of the printer's page, with no dialog.
The Printer Setup button: the printer's own page setup dialog, then the size of its page.
